CREATE TABLE "olist"."public"."order_payments" (
    "order_id" text NOT NULL,
    "payment_sequential" integer NOT NULL,
    "payment_type" text NOT NULL,
    "payment_installments" integer NOT NULL,
    "payment_value" double precision NOT NULL
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 3. Order payment value = SUM(payment_value) for that order. One order can have multiple payment rows. NEVER join order_payments to order_items directly (causes row multiplication).

CREATE TABLE "olist"."public"."customers" (
    "customer_id" text NOT NULL, -- Order-level customer ID. Created per order!
    "customer_unique_id" text NOT NULL, -- Person-level customer ID! Always count customer_unique_id for number of customers / people.
    "customer_zip_code_prefix" integer,
    "customer_city" text,
    "customer_state" text
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 1. Customer (a person) = customers.customer_unique_id. Counting customer_id counts orders, not unique people!

CREATE TABLE "olist"."public"."geolocation" (
    "geolocation_zip_code_prefix" bigint,
    "geolocation_lat" double precision,
    "geolocation_lng" double precision,
    "geolocation_city" text,
    "geolocation_state" text
);

CREATE TABLE "olist"."public"."orders" (
    "order_id" text NOT NULL,
    "customer_id" text NOT NULL, -- Join to customers.customer_id.
    "order_status" text NOT NULL, -- 'delivered', 'shipped', 'canceled', 'unavailable', etc.
    "order_purchase_timestamp" text, -- Stored as text! Cast to ::timestamp.
    "order_approved_at" text, -- Stored as text! Cast to ::timestamp.
    "order_delivered_carrier_date" text, -- Stored as text! Cast to ::timestamp.
    "order_delivered_customer_date" text, -- Stored as text! Cast to ::timestamp.
    "order_estimated_delivery_date" text -- Stored as text! Cast to ::timestamp.
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 2. Sales / sold: excludes canceled and unavailable orders: order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable').
-- 4. Delivered: order_status = 'delivered'. Late: order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp > order_estimated_delivery_date::timestamp.
-- 5. Delivery time: days between order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp and order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp.
-- 8. Date columns are stored as text; cast them to timestamp (e.g. ::timestamp) before date operations or comparisons.

CREATE TABLE "olist"."public"."order_items" (
    "order_id" text NOT NULL, -- Join to orders.order_id.
    "order_item_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "product_id" text NOT NULL, -- Join to products.product_id.
    "seller_id" text NOT NULL, -- Join to sellers.seller_id.
    "shipping_limit_date" text,
    "price" double precision NOT NULL, -- Sales price. Sales amount = price (freight_value is NOT sales).
    "freight_value" double precision NOT NULL -- Freight fee (NOT sales).
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 2. Sales and 'sold' apply to order_items where orders.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable'). Price is the sales amount.

CREATE TABLE "olist"."public"."order_reviews" (
    "review_id" text NOT NULL,
    "order_id" text NOT NULL,
    "review_score" integer NOT NULL,
    "review_comment_title" text,
    "review_comment_message" text,
    "review_creation_date" text, -- Stored as text! Cast to ::timestamp.
    "review_answer_timestamp" text
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 7. If an order has multiple reviews, use the most recent one (ORDER BY review_creation_date::timestamp DESC).

CREATE TABLE "olist"."public"."products" (
    "product_id" text NOT NULL,
    "product_category_name" text, -- Portuguese category name.
    "product_name_lenght" double precision,
    "product_description_lenght" double precision,
    "product_photos_qty" double precision,
    "product_weight_g" double precision,
    "product_length_cm" double precision,
    "product_height_cm" double precision,
    "product_width_cm" double precision
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 6. Category: English name from product_category_name_translation. If no translation, use product_category_name. Products with NULL category are ignored for category questions.

CREATE VIEW "olist"."public"."real_sales" AS SELECT oi.*, o."customer_id", o."order_purchase_timestamp"::timestamp AS "purchase_timestamp" FROM "olist"."public"."order_items" oi JOIN "olist"."public"."orders" o ON oi."order_id" = o."order_id" WHERE o."order_status" NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable');
CREATE VIEW "olist"."public"."order_payment_totals" AS SELECT "order_id", SUM("payment_value") AS "total_payment_value" FROM "olist"."public"."order_payments" GROUP BY "order_id";

CREATE VIEW "olist"."public"."product_categories_english" AS SELECT p."product_id", COALESCE(t."product_category_name_english", p."product_category_name") AS "category_name_english" FROM "olist"."public"."products" p LEFT JOIN "olist"."public"."product_category_name_translation" t ON p."product_category_name" = t."product_category_name" WHERE p."product_category_name" IS NOT NULL;
